@graph.name: Is VOS a REKKI alternative, and is it better than REKKI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Different propositions, so take it in two parts. They automate the work your office does on orders that have already arrived, plus the inbox and the upselling, and VOS changes the way one group of customers orders so that less of that work exists. On accuracy we will not claim a better percentage. In VOS nothing reads the order, so there is no figure for you to take on trust: the lines come off the account's own guide and the buyer looks at them before sending. An order can still be wrong if somebody confirms the wrong quantity.

@graph.name: So can an order still be wrong?

acceptedAnswer.text: Of course. Somebody can confirm the wrong quantity, as they can on any order ever placed. What cannot happen is a mistake nobody saw, because the person who wants the goods read the lines last. And the limit is worth stating: this covers orders placed in the app. A call or a voicemail to your desk gets no number, no timestamp and nothing moving against stock.

At moving an order out of a kitchen with nothing in the middle, we think so. At reading email, triaging an inbox, finding what an account is not buying from you yet, or putting you in front of new buyers, no: we do none of those and have no plans to.

@graph.name: How much do we have to train it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nothing at all, and that is a real difference rather than a slogan. They are open that the training is yours to do, which is fair. We load your guides and open accounts, so there is no learning period and nothing to correct afterwards.

@graph.name: Some of our customers already use the REKKI app. What happens?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nothing breaks. Their chef app is free and, by their own account, sends orders to suppliers whether or not the supplier signed up, converting them to email for your order address. Those keep arriving as they do now. VOS is for the accounts you would rather had a guide of yours in front of them instead.

They are more open here than we are, and that deserves saying: their site carries an opening figure per customer and what it includes. It is quoted in pounds, and their marketplace is described as UK only, while the app itself is described as working anywhere in the world. Ours is quote-based and nothing is published, so ask and you will get a figure for your own book.

@graph.name: How fast could this be running?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most distributors are running it in 24 to 48 hours, and most kitchens get one away that day. Nothing is being integrated or taught, which is why a REKKI alternative gets shortlisted by teams with a single problem to settle this week.
